title: AI/ML Senior Engineer
description:
Requisition Number: 78189
   

  

**The company built on breakthroughs.
   

  

 Join us.**
 Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.
   

  

 How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.
   

  

 At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at\-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.
   

  

 Come break through with us.
   

  

 Corning’s Businesses Are Ever\-evolving To Best Serve Our Customers, Industries, And Consumers. Today, We Accelerate And Transform Life Sciences, Mobile Consumer Electronics, Optical Communications, Display, Automotive, And Solar Markets. We Are Changing The World With
   

  

* Trusted products that accelerate drug discovery, development, and delivery to save lives
* Damage\-resistant cover glass to enhance the devices that keep us connected
* Optical fiber, wireless technologies, and connectivity solutions to carry information and ideas at the speed of light
* Precision glass for advanced displays to deliver richer experiences
* Auto glass and ceramics to drive cleaner, safer, and smarter transportation
* Solar polysilicon, wafers, and innovative photovoltaic modules, enabling low\-cost solar energy solutions


 Company Overview Corning is a global leader in materials science, leveraging its expertise in specialty glass, ceramics, and optical physics to create innovative products that shape industries and improve lives. With over 170 years of innovation, Corning continues to invest in advanced analytics, data science, and Generative AI to enable enterprise\-wide digital transformation.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The Junior AI/ML Engineer – Generative AI Products is a role supporting Corning’s Enterprise Generative AI platform as well as AI/ML initiatives across the company. This position focuses on building, testing, and supporting data science and machine learning solutions, including forecasting models, analytics workflows, and Generative AI use cases, under the guidance of senior data scientists and engineers.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support development and validation of machine learning and statistical models for business use cases
* Assist in building forecasting and predictive models using established techniques and libraries
* Contribute to Generative AI use cases including prompt development, evaluation, and basic experimentation with LLMs
* Support Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows including document ingestion, embeddings, and retrieval
* Perform data preparation, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis
* Work with structured and unstructured data from enterprise sources and AI platforms
* Collaborate with software engineers to integrate models into applications and pipelines
* Help document models, assumptions, results, and data pipelines
* Monitor model performance and assist with troubleshooting and improvements
* Participate in agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives
* Build scalable AI/ML models for given use cases, including price elasticity and recommendation systems, ensuring applicability/reusability across multiple business units.
* Leverage tools such as Databricks and AWS SageMaker to manage data, build models, and deploy solutions.
* Collaborate with stakeholders, understanding their needs and translating them into AI/ML solutions.
* Continually monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of AI/ML models and forecasting techniques, making necessary adjustments to optimize performance.
* Stay abreast of the latest AI/ML trends and technologies, identifying opportunities for innovation and improvement.


 Education \& Experience
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Typically requires 2–4 years of experience in data science, analytics, or machine learning roles, or equivalent academic and project experience.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with data science libraries (pandas, NumPy, scikit\-learn)
* Basic understanding of machine learning algorithms and statistical modeling techniques
* Experience working with SQL and relational or NoSQL databases
* Exposure to cloud or data platforms such as Databricks or AWS
* Familiarity with version control tools such as Git
* Ability to clearly communicate data insights and document work
* Experience working in agile or Scrum\-based teams


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to Generative AI models or LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic)
* Familiarity with time\-series forecasting methods (ARIMA, Prophet, or similar)
* Basic experience with vector databases or similarity search concepts
* Experience using notebook environments such as Jupyter
* Interest in enterprise AI platforms, data governance, and scalable solutions

title: Principal Architect
description:
At S\&W, we help our clients thrive by simplifying the complex, illuminating new paths, and shaping solutions that make a difference. As one of the UK’s top 10 fastest\-growing accountancy firms, we have been a trusted partner since 1881—helping businesses and individuals meet challenges and seize opportunities across generations.
   

  





 Built on expertise and driven by ambition, we provide a comprehensive range of services, including tax and accountancy, advisory and assurance, corporate finance, and restructuring. We are defined by our purpose—to help navigate challenges, unlock potential, and achieve the extraordinary.
   

  





 S\&W acquired ClearViewIP in September 2025 to complement the existing advisory services that S\&W currently offers its clients including corporate finance, valuations, transaction services and forensic services, along with business tax, audit, consulting and business outsourcing services.
   

  





 The ClearViewIP team comprises experienced IP professionals, with decades of experience in managing, protecting and commercialising innovation and ensuring best practice IP approaches are deployed to help clients win in the market.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Principal Architect – AI\-First IP Intelligence Platform**
  

 We are transforming a global IP intelligence organization from expert\-driven workflows into an AI\-first, scalable platform architecture. Our mission is to convert complex, knowledge\-intensive IP workflows\-prior art search, patent landscape analysis, FTO, competitive intelligence\-into modular, explainable, enterprise\-grade AI systems.
   

  




* **Location:** 
 Gurugram, India
* **Working format:** 
 5 days per week in the office



  

  





**The Role**




 You will work closely with the Director and Head of the Workbench Program in the UK, and partner with the India operations team to understand how the work is done today and translate that into the platform. This is an architecture role with long\-term platform ownership and significant technical influence. It is not about maintaining existing systems. The foundations are being laid now, and you will be shaping them hands\-on:
   

  




* AI\-native workflows that reason over long technical documents and cite evidence
* Backend services that orchestrate large analytical workloads across a data platform, and the APIs around them.
* Modern frontend experiences built for reviewing output at scale (React/NodeJS or equivalent) \- a near\-term critical path for this hire
* Secure, enterprise\-grade Azure\-based deployments, with Databricks as the current leading platform for the data/AI layer.
* Robust DevOps and MLOps foundations, including model evaluation



 You will operate at both strategic and hands\-on levels\-designing long\-term architectural blueprints while actively shaping core systems in their earliest stages. This role is not about maintaining existing systems. It is about laying the foundations for a platform that will define the next decade of the company’s growth.
   

  





  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**Technical Strengths**



* 12\-15\+ years in software engineering, with significant architectural ownership
* Experience building large\-scale, distributed, enterprise\-grade systems
* Proven, hands\-on track record designing and building modern backend AND frontend architectures \- frontend/UI depth is essential, not a nice\-to\-have, for this role
* Strong experience in Azure cloud deployments; hands\-on Databricks experience (PySpark, Delta Lake, MLflow) strongly preferred



  

  





**Technical Depth**



* Polyglot capability (Python, TypeScript, Java, Go, Node.js or similar)
* Data storage and query design: SQL, Delta / Lakehouse patterns, search indexes
* Structured extraction from long documents; structured\-output contracts with LLMs
* Batch inference at scale, and the failure modes of long\-context model calls
* Infrastructure\-as\-code and CI/CD pipeline design
* APIs and service design
* Desirable: vector databases, semantic search, RAG architectures \- though our work leans more on verified structured extraction than on retrieval alone
* Vector databases, Semantic search systems, RAG architectures, Knowledge graphs



  

  





**Domain Advantage (Preferred)**



* Experience in IP analytics, patent intelligence, legal tech, or other knowledge\-intensive domains
* Exposure to patent data formats, citation networks, IPC/CPC classifications
* Experience building explainable systems in regulated or high\-trust environments

title: AI Platform Architect
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 As an AI Platform Architect, you will design, evaluate, and lead the rollout of enterprise\-scale AI platforms, including Generative AI, Agentic AI, orchestration layers, and shared AI services across a multi\-cloud environment. Your day will involve defining platform strategy, guiding architecture decisions, and enabling scalable adoption of AI solutions across business units. You will work at the intersection of AI architecture, cloud platform engineering, and enterprise enablement, ensuring reliable, secure, and high\-performing AI platforms.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Design scalable, secure, and reusable AI platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Establish architectural standards for AI lifecycle management, observability, security, and governance.
* Evaluate Agentic AI platforms, frameworks, and orchestration tools, including multi\-agent systems.

* Drive standardization across platforms, tools, and delivery frameworks.


**What You Bring**
* 8–10\+ years of experience in AI platforms, cloud architecture, or platform engineering.
* Proven expertise in multi\-cloud architecture and platform scaling.
* Strong experience with cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* Hands\-on experience with DevOps tools such as Terraform, GitHub/GitLab/Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and GitOps.
* Proficiency in programming and scripting languages including Python, Bash, PowerShell, and YAML.
* Experience with Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS, and GKE.
* Expertise in observability, monitoring, and automated deployment frameworks.
* Experience with AI platform components such as Agentic AI frameworks, orchestration layers, model serving, and AI workflows.

title: Fractional GTM Engineering Lead- US Enterprise
description:
Experience: 5\+ years
 



 Engagement: Freelance / Contract
 



 Market: US Enterprise B2B SaaS
 



  





**About Salesmonk** 




 Every company on earth pours money into events, and almost all of it vanishes. Booths, flights, a week of a team's life, and what's left is a stack of badges nobody works.
 



 SalesMonk is rebuilding that entire motion with AI. Our agents compress weeks of field\-team work into days, with humans in the loop where it counts, and have the room booked before the doors open.
 



 We turn one of the most wasted line items in B2B into a predictable source of pipeline. It's a massive problem, almost nobody is solving it well, and we're moving fast. We're a small, technical team building alongside the founders.
 



  





**Why this role exists:** 




 We’re looking for an experienced Fractional GTM Engineering Lead to
 **build, run and lead** 
 outbound systems for enterprise accounts in the US market.
 



 You’ll work across targeting, account intelligence, enrichment, automation, sequencing and campaign execution to help us break into complex enterprise accounts.
 



 You’ll work closely with the founders and own the GTM system from strategy through execution.
 



  





**What you'll own:** 




 1\.
 **Enterprise targeting \& account intelligence** 




 Build highly targeted account lists using firmographic, technographic, intent and signal data. Map buying committees, identify the right personas and understand how to approach multiple stakeholders within an account.
 



 2\.
 **Build the outbound infrastructure** 




 Design enrichment pipelines, multi\-provider waterfalls, signal triggers, routing logic and automated workflows across tools like Clay, Bitscale, n8n, Common Room and similar platforms.
 



 3\.
 **Run enterprise outbound campaigns** 




 Build and manage coordinated email, LinkedIn and other outbound motions targeting US enterprise accounts. Own campaign architecture, experimentation, deliverability and performance.
 



 4\.
 **Build AI into the workflow** 




 Use AI for account research, enrichment, personalization and workflow automation while keeping human judgment where enterprise selling requires deeper context.
 



 5\.
 **Optimize for pipeline** 




 Track campaign and account\-level performance, identify what’s working and continuously improve targeting, messaging, workflows and campaign strategy.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 



* 5\+ years of experience across GTM Engineering, Growth, RevOps, Sales Ops or technical outbound.
* Strong experience working with US B2B SaaS and enterprise accounts.
* Proven experience building outbound and enrichment workflows from scratch.
* Strong understanding of enterprise account research, buying committees, multi\-threading and account\-based outbound.
* Hands\-on experience with Clay, Bitscale, Freckle or similar workflow/enrichment tools.
* Experience running multi\-channel outbound campaigns with ownership of deliverability.
* Comfortable connecting APIs, webhooks and automation workflows without relying on engineering.
* Strong understanding of pipeline, conversion metrics and revenue operations.
* Ability to work independently and own outcomes in a freelance environment.



  





**The Stack:** 




 Clay / Bitscale / Freckle or similar, Smartlead or Instantly, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Prospeo / FullEnrich, Common Room / Trigify, n8n and HubSpot / Salesforce.
 



 Tool expertise is secondary. We care more about your ability to think across the stack as one system, design the right logic and quickly learn whatever tool gets the job done.
 



 SQL, Python and Claude Code are a strong plus.
 



  





**You're a fit if:** 




 You think in systems, understand how enterprise buying works and can point to pipeline you’ve generated, not just activity you’ve logged.
 



 You’re equally comfortable researching a Fortune 1000 account, designing an enrichment workflow, troubleshooting an automation and looking at campaign data to decide what needs to change.
 



  





**How we work:** 




 We care about qualified enterprise opportunities and pipeline generated, not the number of emails or calls made.
 



 You’ll have the autonomy to build, experiment and iterate, while working closely with the SalesMonk founders on strategy and execution.

title: Financial Engineer
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
   

  

 If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
   

  

**Skills And Competencies**
* The ideal candidate should possess the following skills and experience – At least 2\-4 years of relevant work experience in the area of securitization, preferably having cash flow modelling experience for any Structured Finance asset class (ABS, RMBS, CMBS, CLO etc)
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills
* Experience with structured query language (SQL), VBA, Python, or other programming languages preferred
* Attention to detail and ability to deliver outputs accurately within the stipulated timeframe
* Excellent team player and able to work with virtual and global cross functional teams
* Excellent spoken and written communication as well as receptive listening skills, with ability to present complex ideas in a clear, concise fashion to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity, along with exposure to workflow automation, is highly preferred


**Education**
* An MBA or an equivalent degree is required
* Professional certifications, such as CFA or FRM, are considered an added advantage


**Responsibilities**
* A Financial Engineer in the India Cash Flow Modelling team will collaborate globally to build waterfall models for structured finance deals to expand US asset class libraries, and improve business processes. Strong knowledge of securitization is essential, as the role involves cross\-training, client support, developing features, and analysing new securitization products
* Develop complex cash flow projection models (including deal structure set up) for US securitization transactions using our proprietary software. You will be tasked with creating and reviewing Cash Flow (Waterfall) model for various US ABS, RMBS and CMBS transactions for external and internal clients, supporting our product and software development teams for these products
* Lead/Participate in quality and productivity enhancement projects
* Lead/Participate modelling and updating tool development and enhancement
* Work closely with each asset class desk and client support teams regarding client challenges, new feature developments, and new securitization product analysis in the market


**About The Team**
 Our Cashflow Modeling Team in India is responsible for deal set up and waterfall modelling of various US securitization deal libraries (ABS, RMBS, CMBS) using our in\-house proprietary modelling and updating tools that contributes towards expanding deal coverage and offer our clients cashflow analytics across various asset classes
   

  

 Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
   

  

 Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Role:** 
 Lead Data \& AI Platform Engineer
 



**Function:** 
 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

description:
**Senior Technology Lead – Product, Platform \& Infrastructure** 




**Experience:** 
 5–9 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram / Delhi NCR
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Company:** 
 KonProzTech Private Limited
 



**Compensation:** 
 Competitive fixed compensation \+ performance\-linked growth. ESOP participation will be considered after completion of 1 year, based on performance, ownership and contribution.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





**KonProzTech Private Limited is the parent company that is building various products in the domain of tax, finance, consulting and compliance areas.** 




**VIDUR is our 1st flagship product that is today live in 170\+ cities with 11,000\+ users growing with 30% MoM.** 




**We recently also launched VMUS, AI native consulting tech platform for boutique consulting for India Inc., MSME and startups.** 




**KonProz has built enterprise grade AI Agents for clients like Nirmal Bang, NexEdge capital in the domain of Insurance and Wealth sector.** 




**We are looking for a Senior Technology Lead who can take end\-to\-end ownership of our technology — products, infrastructure, engineering team, scalability, security and technical decision\-making.** 




**This is not a role where you will only manage developers or attend sprint meetings.** 




**We need someone who can look at the complete technology ecosystem, understand what can go wrong before it goes wrong, step into difficult situations when required and make sure the technology team keeps moving.** 




**You will work closely with the founders and will gradually become the key technology owner across VIDUR’s products and enterprise solutions.** 




  





**What You Will Own Product \& Technology** 



* Take overall technology ownership across VIDUR’s web, mobile, AI and enterprise products.
* Understand the architecture and dependencies across existing products.
* Work closely with product, business and founders to convert business requirements into practical technology execution.
* Review architecture and make decisions around scalability, reliability and performance.
* Evaluate new technologies, AI models, tools and infrastructure where they can improve the product.







**Infrastructure \& Reliability** 



* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment architecture, databases, APIs, monitoring and system reliability.
* Identify infrastructure risks before they turn into production issues.
* Build proper monitoring, alerts, backups, redundancy and recovery processes.
* Handle critical production issues and exception scenarios with the team.
* Improve system performance, scalability and infrastructure costs as the business grows.
* **Engineering Team**
* **Understand the technical capability required for each product and build the right engineering team accordingly.**
* **Allocate developers and technical resources based on product priorities.**
* **Conduct technical interviews and help us hire strong engineers.**
* **Mentor developers and improve engineering standards across the team.**
* **Identify capability gaps, performance issues and dependency risks early.**
* **Build a culture where engineers take ownership instead of waiting for instructions.**
* **Engineering Processes**
* **Establish strong standards around code quality, code reviews, documentation, testing and releases.**
* **Ensure that products are being built with long\-term maintainability in mind.**
* **Create clear development, deployment and incident\-management processes.**
* **Maintain visibility over technical debt and make sure critical issues do not keep getting postponed.**
* **Challenge technical decisions when there is a better or more scalable approach. Risk \& Problem Solving**
* **A major part of this role is seeing problems early. We expect you to:**
* **Identify technology red flags before they become business problems.**
* **Think through failure and exception scenarios while building products.**
* Ask “what happens if this fails?” before something goes live.
* Take ownership during production incidents instead of passing responsibility between teams.
* Understand root causes rather than applying temporary fixes.
* Balance speed of execution with stability and long\-term architecture.
* **Enterprise \& Leadership Exposure**
* **As VIDUR grows, you will also represent the technology function externally. You should be comfortable:**
* **Joining technical discussions with enterprise clients.**
* **Understanding enterprise requirements around integrations, APIs, security, infrastructure and**
* **data.**
* **Explaining our technology architecture in simple business language.**
* **Participating in technology discussions with investors and potential strategic partners.**
* **Responding confidently to technical due\-diligence questions.**
* **Working with founders on technology roadmap, product roadmap and future team requirements.**
* **You do not need to be a salesperson, but you should be able to represent the technology behind VIDUR confidently.**
* **What We Are Looking For**
* **We are looking for someone with 5–9 years of strong technology experience, preferably involving SaaS, AI products, fintech, tax\-tech, consulting\-tech enterprise software or high\-scale B2B platforms.**



  





**You should have:** 



* **Strong understanding of modern web application architecture.**
* **Good understanding of backend systems, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.**
* **Experience working with AWS / Azure / GCP or similar cloud environments.**
* **Understanding of system scalability, security, monitoring and reliability.**
* **Experience managing or mentoring developers.**
* **Ability to review architecture and code even if you are not coding every feature yourself.**
* **Experience handling production systems and real\-world failures.**
* Ability to conduct technical interviews and evaluate engineering talent (How has lifecycle
* changed from SDLC to ADLC).
* Strong communication skills for discussions with founders, investors and enterprise clients.
* Experience working with AI/LLMs, RAG, vector databases, document processing or AI\-native products would be a strong advantage.
* More Important Than the Tech Stack
* We care significantly about how you think. We want someone who:
* Thinks like an owner aka family;
* Takes responsibility when something breaks.
* Challenges assumptions instead of blindly executing requirements.
* Can operate with ambiguity.
* Is comfortable making decisions.
* Flags risks early, even when nobody has asked about them.
* Can go deep into a technical issue when required.
* Understands both technology and its business impact.
* Is willing to take on difficult problems.
* Can build systems and teams, not just features.
* If your first question when something goes wrong is “Who is responsible for this?”, this may not be the right role.
* If your first question is “What happened, how do we fix it, and how do we ensure it does not happen again?”, we would like to speak with you.
* What Success Looks Like
* Within the first year, we would expect you to:
* Have a strong understanding of the complete VIDUR technology architecture.
* Reduce critical production and infrastructure risks.
* Create better visibility over system performance and reliability.
* Build stronger engineering processes.
* Identify and close important skill gaps within the technology team.
* Improve the quality and speed of product releases.
* Create a scalable technical roadmap for future VIDUR products.
* Become the go\-to technology person for founders, enterprise clients and the engineering team.



  





**Why Join VIDUR** 



* **This role gives you the opportunity to take genuine technology ownership without being restricted to one engineering function.**
* **You will work directly with the founders, influence product and architecture decisions, participate in enterprise and investor discussions, build the engineering organization and help shape the next phase of VIDUR.**
* **For someone who demonstrates strong ownership and long\-term commitment, ESOP participation may be explored after completion of 1 year.**
* **This is a role for someone who wants to build — not just manage.**

 The Data Architect \& Data Manager is responsible for defining and governing the end\-to\-end data architecture, data management practices, and business intelligence roadmap for the Logistics Data Domain. This role serves as the bridge between business stakeholders, data engineering teams, analytics professionals, and senior leadership, ensuring that data solutions align with strategic business objectives while adhering to enterprise data governance standards.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Design, maintain, and evolve scalable data architectures and data pipelines in Snowflake, applying proven relational database design principles and modern cloud data platform best practices.
* Define standards for data modeling, integration, transformation, storage, and consumption across logistics data products.
* Review and approve architectural designs, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and data governance standards.
* Guide and mentor Data Engineers in implementing architecture solutions, ensuring compliance with coding standards, performance optimization practices, and data quality requirements.
* Monitor implementation progress and provide technical leadership throughout the development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, Data Analysts, and Visualization Engineers to gather and refine reporting and analytics requirements.
* Evaluate business intelligence requests based on strategic value, business impact, effort, and data readiness.
* Establish and maintain a prioritized analytics backlog and delivery roadmap.
* Resolve conflicts between tactical reporting demands and strategic data initiatives by ensuring alignment with long\-term business objectives.
* Promote reusable data products and self\-service analytics capabilities across the logistics organization.
* Ensure compliance with Data Governance standards, processes, policies, and controls.
* Define and monitor data quality improvement initiatives and remediation plans.
* Establish governance processes to ensure data remains fit for purpose, trusted, and available to support business operations and decision\-making.
* Oversee end\-to\-end data lifecycle management activities from creation through archival and retirement.
* Act as the primary point of contact for logistics\-related data topics.
* Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for logistics processes, transportation data, and supply chain analytics.
* Translate complex technical concepts, data architecture decisions, and analytics outcomes into business\-friendly language for senior management and business stakeholders.
* Facilitate consensus among business and technical teams regarding data priorities, definitions, and governance decisions.
* Act as mediator and decision facilitator when disagreements arise related to data ownership, definitions, quality, architecture, or reporting requirements.
* Provide coaching, mentoring, and performance feedback to Data Engineers, Data Analysts, and Visualization Engineers.
* Foster collaboration and accountability within multidisciplinary data teams.
* Promote adoption of best practices in data engineering, analytics, and governance.
* Develop and execute initiatives to improve data literacy across the Logistics organization.
* Enable stakeholders to make informed, data\-driven decisions through education, communication, and change management activities.
* Monitor and coordinate data\-related project activities across the Logistics Data Domain.
* Track project deliverables, milestones, risks, dependencies, and budgets.

* Act as a trusted advisor for technology and data initiatives.
* Recommend appropriate data roles and skill profiles for projects, including Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Data Analysts, Visualization Engineers, Data Stewards, and Data Architects.
* Assess solution options and recommend fit\-for\-purpose technologies, architectures, and operating models.
* Support strategic planning and digital transformation initiatives through data expertise and thought leadership.


**What You Bring**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Data Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in Data Management, Data Architecture, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, or Analytics.
* Proven experience designing enterprise\-scale data platforms and data pipelines.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary data teams and stakeholder landscapes.
* Experience implementing Data Governance and Data Quality frameworks.

title: Research Engineer, AI
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Research Engineer, AI** 
 to build the models and systems that make visa processing faster, more accurate and more reliable than ever before.
   

  

 You'll take ideas from research to production, testing new approaches across LLMs, agents and document intelligence, and shipping the ones that move real outcomes like approval rates, turnaround times and cost per application.
   

  

 This role is for someone with a strong engineering foundation who loves going deep on hard AI problems, and who gets as much satisfaction from a system that works in production as from a clever idea.
   

  

**The Job**
* Build AI systems that do real work by designing and shipping LLM\-powered agents that reliably complete complex, multi\-step tasks across external tools, APIs and web interfaces.
* Push the frontier of document intelligence by building pipelines that extract, verify and reason over information from unstructured documents and images with high accuracy at scale.
* Define how we measure AI quality by building evaluation frameworks, benchmarks and datasets that show how accurate, reliable and safe our models are across the long tail of real\-world cases, before and after they ship.
* Run experiments that change decisions by comparing models, prompting strategies, fine\-tuning approaches and routing logic to improve accuracy while reducing latency and cost.
* Own systems end to end by taking work from prototype to production, including data pipelines, inference infrastructure, monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop fallbacks for when models aren’t confident.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You'll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 3\-6 years of software engineering experience, including meaningful work building and shipping ML or LLM\-based systems in production.
* Are exceptionally strong in Python and comfortable with the modern AI stack, such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, LLM APIs, vector databases and agent frameworks.
* Have hands\-on experience with LLMs in practice, including prompting, RAG, fine\-tuning, tool use and evals, and understand where each approach works and where it breaks.
* Bring a research mindset with a bias to ship: you form hypotheses, run clean experiments, read papers when they help, and turn results into systems people use.
* Have exposure to document AI, OCR, large\-scale data pipelines, or making inference fast and cost\-efficient at scale.


**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here's What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.
   

  

**Come build the intelligence layer for global travel**

description:

 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

* Develop new methods for multimodal understanding and reasoning, so models can reliably extract, verify and reason over noisy, unstructured real\-world inputs across formats and languages.
* Design and run post\-training research, including fine\-tuning, preference optimisation and reinforcement learning, to push model capabilities beyond what general\-purpose frontier models offer.
* Research calibration, uncertainty estimation and self\-verification so AI systems know when to act autonomously and when to defer to a human.

description:

 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform

 Delhi

 Full\-time

 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media

 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.

This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.

* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.

* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

title: AI Specialist Revenue Operations (India Remote)
description:
**Company Description**
  

 When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.
   

  

 Experience a remote\-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well\-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
   

  

 Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
   

  

  

**Job Description**
  

 The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
   

  

 The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first\-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement \& AI Transformation.
   

  

 This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
   

  

**Core areas of impact include:**
* **Workload Development:** 
 Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:** 
 Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:** 
 Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:** 
 Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first\-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:** 
 Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.


**Responsibilities:**
* **Workload Development:** 
 Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:** 
 Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:** 
 Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:** 
 Monitors live AI workloads, owns first\-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:** 
 Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:** 
 Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:** 
 Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:** 
 Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement \& AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** 
 Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non\-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:** 
 Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.


  

  

**Qualifications**
  

**Proven Characteristics for Success**
* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data\-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action\-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.


**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**
* Hands\-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self\-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.


**Preferred**
* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.


**Education**
* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self\-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.


**Tii Elements**
* **Curiosity:** 
 Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:** 
 Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:** 
 Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal \& external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self\-Awareness \& Impact:** 
 Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.


  

  

**Additional Information**

title: AI/ML Expert
description:
**Job Details**

* Outlier is looking for talented

**You may contribute your expertise by…** 




  




* **Review ML papers.** 
 Analyze research papers on ML, systems, and optimization to build challenge problems for agents that learn through recursive feedback.
* **Build evals.** 
 Write the automated graders and verifiers that score an agent’s attempt and set the rewards.
* **Catch reward hacking.** 
 Author LLM\-judged rubrics that distinguish a genuine solve from an agent gaming the metric or hard\-coding its way to a high score.
* **Test with frontier models.** 
 Run top models against your problem and check that stronger ones outperform weaker ones — and that performance climb across the recursive iterations.
* **Analyze the trajectories.** 
 Review what the model actually did across iterations, diagnose where it failed, and confirm gains come from the feedback loop, not luck.
* **Document it.** 
 Capture the problem design, why it’s hard, how each model performed, and what the failure modes reveal.



  





 Examples of desirable expertise:
 



 \- A completed PhD (degree awarded) in Computer Science, Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics / Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Electrical or Computer Engineering, Physics, Computational Linguistics / NLP, Robotics, Operations Research, Computational Neuroscience, or Computational Biology / Bioinformatics, with 2\+ years of hands\-on Machine Learning / AI work after starting the PhD (industry roles, postdoc, research residency, ML internships, or ML research during the PhD all count)

 \- Current enrollment in a Master's program in Computer Science or a closely related computational field at a US technical university, with visible Machine Learning / AI research or project work

title: Program Officer – Health AI & Digital Health
description:
PATH current employees \- please log in and apply
 **Here**
 PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.
   

  

**Program Officer – Health AI \& Digital Health**
**Location:** 
 New Delhi
   

  

**Organizational Base:** 
 PATH
   

  

**Role:** 
 Embedded with the IndiaAI Mission, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
   

  

**Project Background**
 The Government of India is implementing the
 **IndiaAI Mission** 
 , a national initiative to strengthen India's Artificial Intelligence ecosystem and accelerate the responsible development and adoption of AI for economic and social impact. The Mission is being implemented across seven pillars, including IndiaAI Compute, Foundation Models, AIKosh (IndiaAI Datasets Platform), IndiaAI Application Development, FutureSkills, Startup Financing, and Safe \& Trusted AI.
   

  

 Healthcare is an emerging priority area under the IndiaAI Mission, with ongoing efforts to identify and develop AI solutions addressing healthcare and public health challenges. These efforts include partnerships with health\-sector institutions such as ICMR and initiatives to leverage AIKosh, AI infrastructure and the wider AI innovation ecosystem for healthcare applications.
   

  

 IndiaAI is also expanding its engagement with Central Ministries, State Governments, regulatory bodies, technology companies, startups, academia, research institutions and implementation partners to enable sector\-specific AI deployment and integration with existing government digital platforms.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 PATH is seeking an experienced
 **Program Officer – Health AI \& Digital Health** 
 to provide technical, programmatic and coordination support to the IndiaAI Mission on healthcare and public health priorities.
   

  

 The position will be embedded with the IndiaAI Mission, MeitY, and will serve as a
 **health\-domain bridge between government, healthcare institutions and the AI/technology ecosystem** 
 . The incumbent will support IndiaAI Mission leadership in identifying and prioritizing high\-impact health AI opportunities, assessing AI solutions, facilitating pilots and deployment, strengthening engagement with health\-sector stakeholders, and supporting pathways for validation, adoption and scale\-up.
   

  

 The role will require a balance of
 **health\-domain expertise, technology understanding, program management, stakeholder engagement and execution capability** 
 .
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic and Programmatic Support to IndiaAI Mission Leadership
* Provide day\-to\-day technical and programmatic support on healthcare and public health applications of AI.
* Support identification and prioritization of strategic health\-sector opportunities
* Translate health\-system and public health priorities into actionable AI use cases, programs and potential partnerships.
* Prepare briefing notes, concept notes, presentations, strategic updates and decision\-support materials
* Track key developments in health AI, digital health, technology deployment and relevant government initiatives and provide actionable insights.
* Support planning and coordination of priority health AI initiatives
* Health AI Use\-Case Development, Assessment and Deployment
* Support due diligence and technical assessment of AI solutions, startups, technology partners and proposals under consideration.
* Facilitate progression of suitable solutions from use\-case identification and assessment through pilot, validation, deployment and scale\-up.
* Support development of implementation and scale\-up models for AI solutions in government and public\-sector health settings.
* Work with domain experts, health institutions and technology partners to identify requirements related to workflows, infrastructure, human resources, capacity building
* Support integration of relevant AI applications with existing government digital platforms and health information systems.
* Health Data, AIKosh and Responsible Data Use
* Identify and prioritize high\-value health datasets and data use cases that can support AI research, innovation and public\-sector applications.
* Engage with relevant stakeholders and other data\-holding entities to identify opportunities for responsible contribution and use of health datasets.
* Support assessment of health datasets for AI applications.
* Support initiatives for onboarding and effective utilization of relevant health datasets, models and other resources through AIKosh.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen the health data ecosystem to support development, validation and deployment of AI solutions.
* Government and Ecosystem Engagement
* Serve as a key health\-domain interface between IndiaAI/MeitY and health\-sector stakeholders.
* Coordinate with Central Government ministries and departments, State Governments other relevant stakeholders.
* Engage with AI startups, technology companies, academic institutions, research organizations, industry partners and development partners to identify relevant solutions and opportunities for collaboration.
* Support design and execution of consultations, workshops, roundtables, technical discussions, demonstrations and other stakeholder engagements.
* Build and maintain structured stakeholder and partnership pipelines for priority health AI opportunities.
* Support preparation and follow\-up of senior\-level meetings and engagements.
* Knowledge Management and Communication
* Develop high\-quality technical briefs, presentations, concept notes, reports, case studies and other knowledge products.
* Prepare concise briefing and background materials for senior government officials and stakeholders.
* Document health AI use cases, deployment experiences, implementation learnings and emerging opportunities.
* Support dissemination of evidence, lessons and successful models across relevant stakeholders and forums.
* Represent PATH/IndiaAI engagements at relevant technical, policy and ecosystem forums, as required.


**Expected Deliverables**
 The incumbent will contribute to and/or lead delivery of:
   

  

* A prioritized pipeline of health and public health AI use cases aligned with IndiaAI priorities.
* Technical and implementation assessments of priority AI solutions and potential deployment pathways.
* Concept notes, implementation frameworks and roadmaps for selected health AI initiatives.
* Identification and prioritization of high\-value health datasets and opportunities for AIKosh.
* Technical inputs on responsible health AI, data governance, privacy, ethics and interoperability.
* Structured stakeholder and partnership engagement plans across government, technology, academia and health institutions.
* Periodic progress updates, dashboards, management briefs and decision\-support materials for IndiaAI Mission leadership.
* Policy briefs, technical notes, presentations and other knowledge products.
* Documentation of implementation learnings and recommendations for scale\-up.


**Required Qualifications**
**Education**
**Essential**
* Bachelor’s degree in Medicine, Nursing, Pharmacy, Allied Health Sciences, Paramedical Sciences, Public Health or another relevant health discipline.


**Preferred**
* Postgraduate qualification in Public Health, Health Administration, Health Informatics, Digital Health, Health Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related field.


**Experience**
* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience, with demonstrated experience in one or more of the following:
* Digital health
* Health technology implementation
* AI\-enabled healthcare solutions
* Health informatics
* Digital transformation of health systems
* Technology\-enabled public health programs
* AI/technology deployment in healthcare
* Demonstrated experience in implementation, deployment, validation or scale\-up of digital health and/or AI\-enabled solutions in real\-world healthcare or public\-sector settings.
* Experience translating healthcare or public health requirements into technology solutions, implementation plans or deployment models.
* Experience working with government health programs, ministries/departments, public health institutions, hospitals, medical colleges or large health systems.
* Demonstrated experience in managing or coordinating multi\-stakeholder programs involving government, technology partners, health institutions and/or development organizations.
* Strong experience in preparing technical documents, concept notes, presentations, analytical briefs and senior\-management communications.


**Skills And Competencies**
* Strong understanding of healthcare and public health systems, service delivery and implementation realities.
* Practical understanding of AI, digital technologies and their applications in healthcare; advanced software development expertise is not required.
* Ability to assess AI solutions from both health\-domain and implementation perspectives.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and structured\-thinking skills.
* Excellent program management and coordination capabilities.
* Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation and relationship\-management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including ability to develop concise materials for senior government officials.
* Ability to translate complex health and technology concepts into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-level government environment and coordinate across multiple institutions and disciplines.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, responsiveness and ability to independently drive agreed actions to completion.

title: AI Agent Engineer
description:
**About Manifest Global**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility \- connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans
 **Cialfo** 
 (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools),
 **BridgeU** 
 (university guidance for international schools globally),
 **Kaaiser** 
 (trusted study abroad counseling across India and Southeast Asia), and
 **Explore** 
 (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 What This Role Is
   

 AI agents — systems that reason, plan, take action across tools, and complete real work end\-to\-end — have moved from research demos to production infrastructure in the last eighteen months. The companies that build them well will define the next decade of what software is and what people do.
   

 Manifest Global sits at one of the most operationally complex intersections in the world. Every day, our platforms move students between continents, counselors between conversations, applications between deadlines, universities between recruiting cycles, and agents between thousands of families making generational decisions. The work is high\-stakes, high\-volume, and full of judgment calls — exactly the kind of work that breaks under brittle automation and exactly the kind of work AI agents, built properly, can transform.
   

 That is the bet behind this role. Not chatbots. Not wrappers. Agents that actually do the work — drafting university shortlists with reasoning a counselor would defend, surfacing the right student profile to the right admissions officer, catching the document that's about to make an application fail before a human sees it. Agents that hold context across long workflows. Agents that know when to escalate and when to keep going. Agents that get measurably better as more of the network uses them.
   

 You will build those agents across the Manifest portfolio, in production, at a scale that matters.
   

 What Makes This Role Different
   

 Most companies hiring AI agent builders right now have one of two problems. They have the data but no real product surface to deploy into, so the agents sit in demos waiting for distribution. Or they have the distribution but the underlying data is too fragmented to support agents that work in production. Manifest has both. Cialfo's 2,000\+ schools, BridgeU's international school footprint, Kaaiser's three decades of placement data, Explore's 1,000\+ universities — that is the substrate. Saige, already live inside Cialfo, is proof that AI in this domain works when it is built well. Your job is to extend that surface across the portfolio.
   

 This is not a research role. The agents you build will be used by real counselors, students, admissions officers, and partners within weeks of being shipped, not quarters. The feedback loop is tight. The accountability is direct. If an agent you built makes a bad shortlist, a counselor will tell you the same week. That is the speed at which good AI products get built right now, and it is the speed this role operates at.
   

 The broader EdTech market is contracting. Manifest is growing. AI is the lever — and the people who build the agents will define what the next version of this company looks like.
   

 What You Own
   

**The agent platform**
* Design and build production AI agents across Manifest's brands, starting with the highest\-leverage workflows in counseling, admissions outreach, and operational triage
* Own the architecture decisions: model selection, tool use, memory, evaluation, guardrails, and the orchestration layer that holds it together
* Build the abstractions that turn one good agent into a platform


**Evaluation and reliability**
* Define what "working" means for each agent in measurable terms, and build the evaluation infrastructure that proves it
* Own latency, cost, and accuracy as engineering disciplines, not afterthoughts
* Build the safety layer: when an agent should stop, when it should escalate, when it should ask


**Integration into product**
* Work directly with product and engineering teams across Cialfo, BridgeU, Kaaiser, and Explore to ship agents into the surfaces where users already are
* Translate fuzzy user problems into agent specifications that can actually be built
* Close the loop between user feedback and model behaviour faster than anyone in this industry currently does


**Technical direction**
* Set the standard for how AI agents are built at Manifest — tooling, frameworks, model providers, evaluation harness, deployment patterns
* Stay close enough to the research frontier to know what is becoming possible six months out, and ship accordingly


 What Success Looks Like
   

* The markers below reflect where Manifest's AI agent function is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
* In the first weeks, you have a clear point of view on which workflows across the portfolio are the highest\-leverage places to deploy agents — and you can defend that view to the counselors, product leaders, and engineers who will use what you build. You have started building, not just planning. Something is in the hands of a real user by the end of month three.
* By mid\-period, at least one agent you have built is in production, used daily, and measurably better than the manual workflow it replaced. The evaluation infrastructure exists and is trusted by the people whose work depends on it. Other engineers across the group know how to build agents the Manifest way because you have made that pattern legible.
* Longer term, the agent layer is infrastructure, not a project. New product surfaces ship with AI agents as a default, not an exception. The work you built outlasts the specific models you started with, because the architecture you chose absorbed model upgrades without rewriting from scratch. The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.


 What You Bring
   

* You have spent the better part of your career building software that runs in production — and somewhere in the last two years, you became one of the people other engineers go to when they have a hard question about LLMs, agents, or how to actually make this stuff work outside a notebook. You have shipped something agentic. Not a prototype. Something users use.
* You know the current frontier well enough to be opinionated about it. You have working views on which model providers to use for what, which orchestration patterns hold up under real load, where the abstractions in popular agent frameworks leak, and how to evaluate something that doesn't have a single correct answer. You write production\-quality Python. You are comfortable with the surrounding stack: vector stores, prompt management, evaluation frameworks, observability tooling.
* You think in systems, not in prompts. When you see a workflow, you instinctively map where reasoning happens, where state lives, where tools get called, where humans need to stay in the loop. You build for the model that ships in six months, not the one that exists today.
* You are self\-directed in the way this kind of role requires. There is no finished playbook for what you are building. The questions you will face — which agent to build next, how much to invest in evaluation infrastructure, when to use a smaller model and when to use a frontier one — will not have obvious answers. You make calls, you ship, you learn, you adjust.
* Somewhere underneath the technical depth, you care about what the agents you build actually do in the world. The fact that a student in Delhi or Manila or Lagos is going to make a better university decision because of code you wrote — that matters to you.
* Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building in AI and your first reaction was the agents I want to build are exactly the ones this company needs built. That's the person this role is for.


 Why Manifest
   

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 For this role specifically, the AI agents you build are not adjacent to the mission — they are the mission's primary lever. Counselors cannot serve every student who needs guidance. Universities cannot manually reach every qualified applicant. Operations teams cannot manually track every application across every destination. The only way the infrastructure we are building reaches the scale the problem actually demands is through AI agents that hold their own in real work. That is what this seat is for.
   

*Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50\+ countries.*
